components.label: Investments Total
components.source: Filing accession 0001193125-26-224183, Schedule of Investments table 22, row 39, Market Value column: Investments Total $1,815,082 (in thousands)

evidence.quote: Schedule of Investments table 22 row 39: Investments Total | Cost $1,811,390 | Market Value $1,815,082 | 180.5% of NAV (amounts in thousands).

Schedule of Investments table 22 rows 17, 30, and 38: Non-Controlled/Non-Affiliate Investments Total market value $1,735,938; Non-Controlled/Affiliate Investments Total market value $28,222; Controlled Affiliate Investments Total market value $50,922 (amounts in thousands).

Balance sheet table 6 rows 6-8 reports fair values of $1,735,938, $28,222, and $50,922 thousand for non-controlled/non-affiliate, non-controlled affiliate, and controlled affiliate investments, respectively; table 6 row 21 reports Total Assets of $2,089,533 thousand.

rationale: The filing provides an explicit Investments Total row after all three investment classifications. Its market value is $1,815,082 thousand, exactly equal to the sum of the three schedule subtotals ($1,735,938 + $28,222 + $50,922 thousand) and to the three investment lines on the balance sheet. It also equals the companyfacts investments-at-fair-value tag, showing that the tag captured the complete portfolio rather than only the non-affiliated schedule. The total is 86.9% of total assets, a plausible balance-sheet closure for a BDC; cash and other assets explain the remainder.
